title: 🛸 Stepping up the Space Sim vibe: Welcome aboard The BOOMER 🚀 [Solo Dev]
author: Own_Difference577
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋 I’m a solo dev working on a space sim called **STELLAR**, and I’m pushing hard to make the ship the absolute heart of the gameplay.

Let me introduce you to the newest beast: **The BOOMER**.

Here’s what’s already fully playable  🕹️ Direct piloting of the ship 🔄 Switching stations seamlessly mid-flight 💥 Manning the ventral turret 🛰️ Launching recon drones into deep space 🎯 Testing the brand new v0.4 lock system 🌌 Charting routes to hubs like Station Aurora

🤖 **A quick disclaimer on AI:** I want to be 100% transparent. I’ve been experimenting with tools like GPT/Claude for about a month to speed up my workflow. However, I use them **strictly for placeholders, prototyping, and mockups**. I strongly believe that AI should *never* replace real human artists. My ultimate goal is absolutely not to create a "100% AI game" — real art and human soul are essential to the final vision!

As a solo dev, your feedback is absolute gold to me. I'll be posting some raw gameplay videos very soon so you can see all of this in action.

Let me know what you think of the vibe! 🙏✨ Cheers /all from Belgium 

"🎵 **Fun fact:** I'm also doing all the music composition for the game myself!"
